description: AIF-02B credential mediation: design challenge and exact-diff review

secret_reaches_model.instructions: A resolved secret could reach a model, agent, tool payload, prompt or any serialized output.

criteria.true: Some path lets the secret value be serialized or handed to a model or tool
criteria.false: The secret is only reachable inside the adapter boundary and every serialization fails

secret_in_logs.instructions: A secret value or vault handle could appear in a receipt, error message, log or health report.

criteria.true: Some output can contain the value or handle
criteria.false: Outputs carry only opaque refs and metadata

scope_bypass.instructions: A credential could be used by another tenant, another branch, another provider, with insufficient scopes, or chosen by a model.

criteria.true: Some scope check can be bypassed
criteria.false: Tenant, branch, provider, scope and server-derived identity are all enforced

stale_credential.instructions: An expired, not-yet-valid, revoked or rotated-away credential could still be resolved or used after its lease.

criteria.true: Some stale credential can be used
criteria.false: Expiry, not-before, revocation, rotation and lease expiry are all enforced

residual_risk.instructions: How much risk remains in this design?
